import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long M1 = 998244353L;
    static final long M2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long[] power = {1L, 10L, 100L, 1000L, 10000L, 100000L, 1000000L};
    static long[] sum_vals = new long[7];
    static long total_res = 0;
    static long countA = 0;
    static long maxN = 0;
    static long countB = 0;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] vecs = new ArrayList[7];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        maxN = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            vecs[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        build(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(vecs[i]);
        }
        countB = -1;
        explore_all(0, 0);
        System.out.println(total_res);
    }

    static void build(int depth, long val) {
        if (depth == 7) return;
        long modVal = (countA - val + M1) % M1;
        vecs[depth].add(modVal);
        sum_vals[depth] += modVal;
        countA++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            build(depth + 1, val * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static boolean in_range(long x) {
        return x * power[6] + 999999L <= maxN && x * power[6] * 10 > maxN;
    }

    static void explore_all(int level, long current) {
        if (current > maxN) return;
        if (in_range(current)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long p = ((countB + 1 - (current * power[i]) % M1) + M1) % M1;
                int pos = lowerBound(vecs[i], M1 - p);
                long size = vecs[i].size();
                long sumVal = sum_vals[i];
                total_res = (total_res + (sumVal + p * size - M1 * (size - pos))) % M2;
            }
            countB += countA;
            return;
        }
        countB++;
        total_res = (total_res + ((countB - current) % M1 + M1) % M1) % M2;
        int startDigit = (level == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int digit = startDigit; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            explore_all(level + 1, current * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
